text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On nights with a new moon, Admire Vega 
always goes to converse with her late 
sister, with whom she is faintly connected 
through the stars.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To run in her sister's place and dedicate 
all the glory she achieved to her, and to 
once again embrace that vow deep within 
her heart...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, to keep Admire Vega from running 
all alone, her Trainer threw themselves 
into trying everything they possibly 
could.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their relationship remained awkward. Even 
so, the days of taking on the Twinkle 
Series together had undeniably begun.
